name: LPU Dining & Food Portal
description: Official Dining and Food Delivery Portal for Lovely Professional University (LPU), Phagwara, Punjab. Features LPU UniMall food stalls, Law Gate & Maheru eateries within 10 km radius, Boys & Girls Hostel delivery (BH-1 to BH-8, GH-1 to GH-6), Academic Block parcels (Block 34, 38, 14, 55), live stall queue meters, meal QR check-in, and 24x7 Verto helpline support.
